verdict.rationale: Extend's parsing docs list a dedicated "Figures, charts, diagrams, and equations" section, and the pricing page claims image detection, so figure handling is a first-party parse capability. The evidence is only headings, though, with no detail on what figure output looks like. The extraction citations that "point back to the exact spot on the page" cover extracted fields, not figures, so they don't count toward figure traceability. Missing for 10: documented VLM summaries or descriptions of figures/charts, image-crop output, bounding-box or page-position metadata for figure blocks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of figure parsing quality.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: Detect tables, checkboxes, images, and handwriting
